auditLogLabel.where: Manage > People: name of the audit-log section, shown in its error fallback if it fails to load

auditEmpty.where: Manage > People > Access Audit Log: empty state

auditChangedRole.where: Manage > People > Access Audit Log: one line per role change
auditChangedRole.context: {actor} is the admin's email name (bold); {target} is the last 6 characters of the user's id (monospace). Keep both placeholders.

auditJustNow.where: Manage > People > Access Audit Log: time of an entry whose server timestamp has not arrived yet

roleAdmin.where: Manage > People: role name in role menus, toasts and the role-change dialog

roleBandLeader.where: Manage > People: role name in role menus, toasts and the role-change dialog

roleMusician.where: Manage > People: role name in role menus, toasts and the role-change dialog

roleMember.where: Manage > People: role name in role menus, toasts and the role-change dialog

rolePending.where: Manage > People: role name for someone waiting for approval

roleDenied.where: Manage > People: role name for someone whose access was refused (badge, filter tab, menus)

userFallbackName.where: Manage > People: stands in for a person's name in button labels when they have neither name nor email

roleUpdateFailed.context: {reason} is the technical error text (may be English)

cannotChangeOwnRole.where: Manage > People: error toast when changing your own role

roleLimit.where: Manage > People: error toast when assigning a role above your own
roleLimit.context: {role} is the viewer's own role name (e.g. Band Leader)

roleUpdated.where: Manage > People: toast after changing, approving or declining a person
roleUpdated.context: {personName} is the person's display name, {role} the new role name

removedFromTenant.where: Manage > People: toast after removing someone from this congregation/band
removedFromTenant.context: {personName} is the person, {tenantName} is the congregation or band's name

requestFailed.where: Manage > People: error detail inside a toast when the server refused

soundEngineerEnabled.where: Manage > People: toast after granting sound-engineer access (mixer)

soundEngineerRemoved.where: Manage > People: toast after removing sound-engineer access

notAuthenticated.where: Manage > People: error detail in the remove-user toast when signed out

failed.where: Manage > People: error detail in the remove-user toast when the server gives no reason

removedUser.where: Manage > People: toast after deleting a user account

badgeAdmin.where: Manage > People: small role badge on a person's row

badgeLeader.where: Manage > People: small role badge on a band leader's row

badgeSound.where: Manage > People: badge for a sound engineer (may run the mixer)

badgePending.where: Manage > People: badge on someone waiting for approval

removeSoundEngineer.where: Manage > People: tooltip of the headphones button

removeSoundEngineerRole.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the headphones button

makeSoundEngineer.where: Manage > People: tooltip and accessible name of the headphones button

removeFromTenant.where: Manage > People: tooltip of the remove button and the confirm button in its dialog
removeFromTenant.context: {tenantName} is the congregation or band's name

removePersonFromTenant.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the remove button
removePersonFromTenant.context: {personName} is the person, {tenantName} the congregation or band

tapAgainToConfirm.where: Manage > People: tooltip of the delete button after the first tap

removeUser.where: Manage > People: tooltip of the delete (trash) button

confirmRemoval.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the delete button after the first tap
confirmRemoval.context: {personName} is the person's name or email

removePerson.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the delete (trash) button
removePerson.context: {personName} is the person's name or email

approveAsLabel.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the role menu next to Approve on a request
approveAsLabel.context: {personName} is the person's name or email; the chosen role follows

rolePlaceholder.where: Manage > People: placeholder of the role menus

approveAsRole.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the Approve button
approveAsRole.context: {personName} is the person, {role} the chosen role name

approve.where: Manage > People: button on a pending request

declinePerson.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the Decline button
declinePerson.context: {personName} is the person's name or email

decline.where: Manage > People: button on a pending request

roleFor.where: Manage > People: accessible name of a person's role menu
roleFor.context: {personName} is the person's name or email

youBadge.where: Manage > People: tiny badge on the viewer's own row

changeRoleBody.context: {personName} is the person, {fromRole} and {toRole} are role names

cancel.where: Manage > People: dialog and bulk-action cancel buttons

changeRoleConfirm.where: Manage > People: confirm button of the role-change dialog

removeFromTenantTitle.context: {tenantName} is the congregation or band's name

removeFromTenantBody.context: {personName} is the person, {tenantName} the congregation or band. Only this membership ends; their account stays.

bulkUpdated.where: Manage > People: toast after a bulk role change
bulkUpdated.context: {count} is a number of people, {role} the role name

bulkPartial.where: Manage > People: warning toast after a bulk role change where some failed

bulkFailed.where: Manage > People: error toast after a bulk role change that failed entirely

pendingRequests.where: Manage > People: amber badge above the list
pendingRequests.context: {count} is a number of people waiting for approval. English uses one form for every count; Hebrew may add plural variants.

selectedCount.context: {count} is a number of selected people. English uses one form; Hebrew may add plural variants.

denyAccessTitle.where: Manage > People: tooltip of the Deny Access bulk button

denyAccessLabel.where: Manage > People: accessible name of the Deny Access bulk button

filterRequests.where: Manage > People: role filter tab showing people waiting for approval

filterLeader.where: Manage > People: role filter tab for band leaders

clearFilters.where: Manage > People: tooltip and accessible name of the clear-filters icon button

columnUser.where: Manage > People: list column header (CSS uppercase)

columnAttributes.where: Manage > People: list column header for role badges (CSS uppercase)

columnRoleManagement.where: Manage > People: list column header (CSS uppercase)

emptyNoMatches.where: Manage > People: empty list after filtering

testAccountsHidden.where: People tab: toggle shown when probe accounts are hidden; click shows them. Plural: count.

testAccountsHide.where: People tab: toggle that hides probe accounts again.
